{{Quote|What's a pretty bald babe like you doing in a desert like this?|Oked to [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], before he was killed|<ref name="Bounty (episode)">{{TCW|Bounty (episode)}}</ref>}}
'''Oked''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] from a [[Unidentified tentacle-faced species/Legends|species of tentacle-faced beings]] and a member of the posse that included the young boy [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], [[Latts Razzi/Legends|Latts Razzi]], [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]], and the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[C-21 Highsinger/Legends|C-21 Highsinger]].

==Biography==
[[File:OkedDead-Bounty.png|thumb|left|200px|Oked impaled by Ventress' lightsaber]]
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], he was present with Bossk and Latts Razzi in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He approached [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and flirted with her. She activated one of [[Asajj Ventress's lightsabers/Legends|her lightsabers]] and ignited it [[Shiak|through]] his chest. The rest of the patrons in the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] barely seemed to notice and went back to their drinks. Bossk approached Ventress afterwards and told her that she had [[Death/Legends|killed]] one of their team. He and Latts agreed to have her replace Oked in the group. His body was later dragged by the [[Unidentified Nimbanel bartender/Legends|bartender]] out of the cantina.
